jinx.reason: An Alchemist-Baron has no Baron ability & knows how many Outsiders are in play. They learn if this ever changes. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
If the Alchemist has the Boffin ability, the Alchemist might not learn what ability the Demon has.
An Alchemist-Mastermind has no Mastermind ability & the Mastermind is not-in-play. They learn when all Minions are dead.
An Alchemist-Mezepheles has no Mezepheles ability & starts knowing a secret word. The 1st good player (not the Alchemist) to say this word is immediately safe from all Minion abilities.
An Alchemist-Scarlet Woman has no Scarlet Woman ability. When the 1st Minion dies, they learn which, and may choose to gain their ability.

An Alchemist-Spy has no Spy ability & a Spy is in play. Each day, a living Alchemist-Spy may publicly guess a living player as the Spy. If correct, the Spy dies tonight & the Demon doesn’t kill tonight. The Spy can't misregister to the Alchemist.
The Alchemist might register as Evil to their own ability.

An Alchemist-Widow has no Widow ability & a Widow is in play. Each day, a living Alchemist-Widow may publicly guess a living player as the Widow. If correct, the Widow dies tonight & the Demon doesn’t kill tonight. The Widow can't poison the Alchemist.

An Alchemist-Wraith has no Wraith ability & a Wraith is in play. Each day, a living Alchemist-Wraith may publicly guess a living player as the Wraith. If correct, the Wraith dies tonight & the Demon doesn’t kill tonight.
An Alchemist-Xaan has no Xaan ability. On night X, all Minions are poisoned until dusk. [X Outsiders]
If the Demon would have the Drunk ability, the Boffin chooses a Townsfolk player to have this ability instead.
If the Cannibal with the Princess ability nominates & executes a player on their first day with the ability, the Demon doesn’t kill tonight, even if they lose their Princess ability.
If the Organ Grinder caused eyes closed voting, at night, the Flowergirl chooses a player: they learn all players that voted on them that day.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
If the Hermit has the Drunk ability, the Hermit does not learn their other Outsider abilities.
If the Hermit has the Heretic ability, the Hermit might only have 2 Outsider abilities.
If the Hermit has the Lunatic ability, the Hermit does not learn their other Outsider abilities.
The Kazali learns the King before choosing minions. The King cannot be chosen by the Kazali.
If the Leviathan and the Mayor are alive on day 5 & no execution occurs, the Mayor's team wins.
If the Magician is alive, the Storyteller chooses which Minion babysits Lil' Monsta. The Minions see the Magician as a Minion.

The Magician starts knowing if a Wraith is in play. Each day, the living Magician may publicly guess a living player as the Wraith. If correct, the Wraith dies tonight & the Demon doesn’t kill tonight.
The Magician starts knowing if a Kazali is in-play.
The Magician starts knowing if a Lord of Typhon is in-play.
If the Marionette thinks that they are the Huntsman, an Outsider might have been added during setup.
The Marionette can neighbor the Recluse.
If the Princess nominated & executed a player on their 1st day, the Po cannot choose no-one tonight.
If the Poppy Grower has their ability, the Wraith doesn't wake with evil players, but may still open their eyes.
If the Poppy Grower is in play, the Kazali chooses which minions, but not which players. The Poppy Grower cannot become a Minion by the Kazali.
If the Princess nominated & executed a player on their 1st day, the Princess learns if a Summoner is in play tonight.
If the Princess nominated & executed a player on their 1st day and the Leviathan is in play, this doesn't register to the Leviathan & the Princess learns an alive player isn't the Leviathan tonight.
If the Princess nominated & executed a player on their 1st day, the Princess learns if a Riot is in play tonight.
During a riot, if the Storyteller is nominated and a majority of players vote, the game ends. If not, they nominate again.
If the Riot is created from the Hatter, the Riot day is the Riot's second day.
An unused Summoner registers as the Demon to the Slayer.
An unused Summoner registers as the Demon to the Golem.
If the Summoner summons a Riot, the Riot happens the next day.
If an Alsaahir is in play, the Storyteller doesn't declare the Vizier is in play.
The Vizier cannot immediately execute the Storyteller.
The Vizier knows any Fearmonger chosen players. The Vizier might fail to immediately execute them.
The Vizier might fail to immediately execute a Goblin that claimed Goblin during their defense.
If an Investigator is in play, the Storyteller doesn't declare the Vizier is in play.
If the Princess nominated & executed a player on their 1st day, on the next night the Zombuul could kill, kills are arbitrary.
